svg.title: HPC Learning Hub Next.js features, 2026-09-04
svg.desc: Routes compose the first Training Library and Material Detail views in one training-library folder. Later public discovery, account, personal learning and AIDA features use shared UI and Gateway transport. Only transport calls NestJS.
